newsitem.title: FRANCE: SCATTERED STORMS SLOW FRENCH GRAIN HARVEST.
newsitem.headline: SCATTERED STORMS SLOW FRENCH GRAIN HARVEST.

text.p: Stormy rain showers interrupted the final stages of the French grain harvest in some northern areas on Wednesday, weather analysts said.

Up to 25 millimetres of rain fell in the Oise area in the south of Picardie, where farmers are trying to finish cutting wheat today or tomorrow. But rainfall was irregular and farmers in many local areas were able to keep working.
Northwest of Paris, violent storms were reported in the Eure department in Upper Normandy. Rain fell overnight in Seine-Maritime near the coast.

Most of France is under a heatwave but the disruption to some grain farmers comes from a system of local storms moving eastwards from the Paris basin and forecast to reach eastern provinces by Wednesday evening.
Temperatures are 23 to 25 degrees Celsius in the north, where the wheat and barley harvest is being completed.
Thursday's outlook is for more hot weather with a few storms in the Alps and western Pyrenees.
